title: Si: band unfolding of the 8-atom cubic cell onto the fcc zone
summary: An environment-dependent Slater-Koster (EDTB) model of silicon with s, p and d orbitals on the 8-atom conventional cubic cell: its bands unfolded onto the Brillouin zone of the 2-atom fcc cell, each state weighted by its spectral weight. No DFT run; seconds.

steps.label: Unfold the bands of the 8-atom cell onto the fcc zone
steps.note: prints the sum rule of the spectral weights; writes si_sc8_unfolded.png
